Epigenomic data are visible at several locations in the Knowledge Portals:

  • in the Genomic Region Miner (GEM) module on Region pages (see an example)
  • in the "Globally enriched annotations" table on Phenotype pages (see an example)
  • in the Variant Sifter tool (see documentation)
  • in the Non-Coding Genetic Association Interactive Tool (NC-GAIT; see documentation)

Epigenomic datasets are initially loaded to the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA). Data are accessed from AMP-CMD consortium members, publicly available sources, and large public resources such as ChIP-Atlas and the Encyclopedia of DNA Elements (ENCODE). Annotations are transferred from CMDGA to the Data Coordinating Center (DCC) and processed with GREGOR (Genomic Regulatory Elements and Gwas Overlap algoRithm) for display on the Knowledge Portals.

More information about epigenomic annotations is available in the Knowledge Portal documentation. Click here to see a searchable list of all genomic annotations currently displayed on the Knowledge Portals.
